## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs`

Start a run

Starts a run of the repository's deployed project version and answers 202. Needs `RUN` on the environment. Answers 404 when the environment or repository does not exist or is not deployed, 409 when another run of the deployment is active, there is no run service account in a protected environment, or the one bound is inactive, and 422 when the selection is malformed or matches nothing.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `RunCreate`

|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `select` | list of text | no |  |
| `upstream` | true or false | no |  |
| `downstream` | true or false | no |  |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs`

List runs

Lists runs, newest first, one page at a time. The cursor of the next page is in the `X-Next-Cursor` response header and is absent on the last page; send the same filters with every page. Needs `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the environment or repository does not exist and 422 for a `limit` below 1, an unknown status or trigger, a `since` without a time zone, or a `cursor` this server did not issue.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Only this repository's runs. |
| `status` | query | no | list of text | Only runs in these statuses (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`); repeat the parameter or separate the values with commas. |
| `trigger` | query | no | list of text | Only runs started this way (`schedule`, `api`, `manual`, `deploy`); repeat or separate with commas. |
| `job` | query | no | text or null | Only runs of this job. |
| `since` | query | no | text (date-time) or null | Only runs created at or after this ISO 8601 time, with a time zone (`2026-10-18T00:00:00Z`). |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most runs returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `X-Next-Cursor` of the previous page. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | list of `RunOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/jobs/{job}/tasks/{task}/attempts`

List a task's attempts across runs

Lists the attempts of one task of one job over all its runs, newest first, with what each used (peak memory, processor time, bytes read), to see which task needs the most memory or whether it grows from run to run. Needs `RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers an empty list for a task the project declares that has not run yet, 404 when the environment or repository does not exist or the job or task is unknown (no deployed project declares it and no run attempted it), 409 when several repositories ran a job of this name and none was named, and 422 for a `limit` outside 1 to 200 or a `cursor` this server did not issue.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `job` | path | yes | text | The job's name. |
| `task` | path | yes | text | The task's name (its table, such as `silver.orders`). |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | The repository; needed only when several repositories ran a job of this name. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most attempts returned (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `TaskHistoryPage` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs/{run_id}/checks/rows`

Queue a query for the rows a check found

Queues an ordinary query of the caller that shows the rows a check found in a run, and answers 202 like the query submit route. It runs the check's SQL under the caller's own grants, row filters and column masks, and reads the table at the snapshot the check read. The body names the check only. Needs `RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`, and `SUBMIT_QUERY`; a task is refused. Answers 404 when the environment or run does not exist or the run has no result for the check, and 409 when the check read no snapshot or the run's project version no longer holds its SQL.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `run_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The run's id. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `CheckRowsRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check` | text | yes |  |

Answers:

|---|---|---|
| `202` | Successful Response | `QuerySubmitOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |

## `POST /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs/{run_id}/resume`

Resume a run

Starts the failed, upstream-failed or cancelled part of a finished run again, and answers 202. Needs `RUN`. Answers 404 when the run does not exist or its repository is no longer deployed, 409 when the run is still active, the current project version changed, or as for starting a run, and 422 when no task failed, was upstream failed or was cancelled.

## `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs/{run_id}/tasks/{asset}/log`

Show a task's log

Returns the task's log text and its attempts. With `offset`, only the text from that byte on (at most 1 MiB, ending before a half character), and the `next_offset` to continue from. Needs `RUN` or `READ_ENVIRONMENT`. Answers 404 when the run or task does not exist.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | path | yes | text | Environment name. |
| `run_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The run's id. |
| `asset` | path | yes | text | The task's dotted table name. |
| `offset` | query | no | whole number or null | Read the log from this byte; omit for the whole log. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

## `GET /api/v1/runs`

List the runs of every environment you may read

Without `environment`, lists the runs of every environment where you hold `READ_ENVIRONMENT`, newest first, in one list. An environment you may not read is left out, so this is never a 403 or a 404. With `environment`, it answers exactly what `GET /api/v1/environments/{env}/runs` answers, with its 403 and 404, in this body. Each run names its `environment` and comes without tasks. Send `next_cursor` back as `cursor` with the same filters for the next page; a cursor of the list of one environment is refused with 422 here. Answers 404 when `repository` does not exist and 422 for a `limit` outside 1 to 200, an unknown status or trigger, a `since` without a time zone, or a `cursor` this server did not issue for this list.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | query | no | text or null | Only this environment. |
| `repository` | query | no | text or null | Narrow to this repository. |
| `status` | query | no | list of text | Narrow to these statuses (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`); repeat the parameter or write them comma-separated. |
| `trigger` | query | no | list of text | Narrow to these triggers (`schedule`, `api`, `manual`, `deploy`), given as `status` is. |
| `job` | query | no | text or null | Narrow to this job. |
| `since` | query | no | text (date-time) or null | Narrow to runs created at or after this ISO 8601 time; a time zone is required. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Page size (1 to 200). |
| `cursor` | query | no | text or null | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `RunPageOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `RunPageOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `RunOut` | yes |  |
| `next_cursor` | text or null | yes |  |

## `GET /api/v1/runs/failed`

List the jobs whose newest finished run failed

Lists, for every environment you may read (`READ_ENVIRONMENT`), each job whose newest finished run within the last seven days failed (or, for runs outside a job, each repository's), newest end first: the same rule as Home's Needs your attention, so the two never disagree. A later success or a later cancelled run hides an earlier failure. Each row names the run's first failed task and why it failed; a run that failed without a failed task has `task` and `failure` null and says why in `run.error_message`. An environment you may not read is left out, never refused. With `environment`, only its runs: 403 without `READ_ENVIRONMENT` on it and 404 when it does not exist. Answers 422 for a `limit` outside 1 to 200. `truncated` says more rows were left out.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | query | no | text or null | Only this environment's runs. |
| `limit` | query | no | whole number | Most rows returned (1 to 200). |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `FailedRunsOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `FailedRunsOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | list of `FailedRunOut` | yes |  |
| `truncated` | true or false | yes |  |
